angle: A surcharge is not an instant escape from suspension; it is one response option to consider only after checking the legal basis, restrictions, and business impact in order.

marketing.targetReader: Business owners reviewing whether a notified suspension may be replaced with a surcharge
marketing.readerQuestion: Can the notified suspension be replaced with a surcharge, and would replacement make business sense?
marketing.practicalPayoff: Readers can review the legal basis, exclusions, calculation route, and business impact in order.
marketing.coverIntent: Use a concrete 15-day suspension and the owner's real question about staying open.
marketing.saveValue: A five-step decision path and evidence checklist to use after receiving advance notice
marketing.performanceHypothesis: Test whether a concrete suspension period and owner question improve final-card reach and review requests.

editorialReview.reviewNote: Approved before pipeline v2.0; review completion was not backfilled

omittedSections: Terminology note on surcharges and administrative fines

cards.oneMessage: Replacing a suspension with a surcharge is not automatic.
cards.headline: A 15-day suspension: can you pay and keep operating?
body: Revenue may stop when the doors close, while rent and payroll continue.
cards.takeaway: But not every suspension may be replaced with a surcharge.
cards.pageTurn: What should you check before estimating the amount?

sourceTrace.heading: 서론
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Recast the concrete scenario as a direct English cover question; preserved the non-automatic qualification.
sourceTrace.omittedQualification: Eligibility depends on the governing law and case-specific facts.

cards.oneMessage: Four questions establish whether a surcharge review should continue.
cards.headline: Before estimating the amount, run these four checks
body: 1 Does the governing Act allow a surcharge?
3 Does a prior disposition restrict it?
4 If available, would it actually help?
cards.takeaway: Legal availability and business value are different questions.
cards.pageTurn: Can the disposition change when the violation remains?

sourceTrace.heading: 30초 만에 먼저 확인해 보세요
sourceTrace.paragraph: 현재 영업정지 사전통지서를 가지고 있다면 다음 네 가지를 순서대로
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Converted the four Korean checks into parallel action questions without removing qualifiers.

cards.oneMessage: The form of disposition may change even when the violation remains.
cards.headline: The violation remained. The suspension became a surcharge.
body: 15-day suspension of a snack bar → surcharge in lieu of 15 days
The Commission did not erase the violation; it changed the form of disposition after considering the circumstances.
cards.takeaway: Disputing the violation and seeking a different disposition are separate strategies.
cards.pageTurn: Why is the industry label not enough?

sourceTrace.heading: 1. 실제로 영업정지 15일이 과징금으로 변경된 사건
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Kept the outcome and distinction; edited the sentence order for natural legal English.
sourceTrace.omittedQualification: The governing provision and full facts must be checked case by case.

cards.oneMessage: Suspensions in different industries follow different statutory structures.
cards.headline: Food, waste and construction cases start in different places
body: Food service — check the violation, count and exclusions
Waste — prove the statutory conditions and check prior surcharge history
Construction — distinguish Article 82 from an Article 83 registration case
cards.takeaway: Start with the legal basis, not the industry label.
cards.pageTurn: In what order should eligibility be screened?

sourceTrace.heading: 2. 내 사건도 가능한지는 ‘업종’보다 ‘근거조항’을 먼저
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Reduced each industry to its distinct legal checkpoint; preserved article numbers.
sourceTrace.omittedQualification: Detailed exclusions and calculation rules are omitted.

cards.oneMessage: Eligibility should be screened through four gates in sequence.
cards.headline: Screen surcharge eligibility in this order
cards.takeaway: If an early gate fails, consider another response before calculating the amount.

sourceTrace.heading: 3. 과징금 전환이 막히는 사건은 먼저 걸러야 합니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Rendered the four Korean filters as a compact sequential process.

cards.oneMessage: Business hardship alone does not prove the statutory conditions.
cards.headline: “Our clients will suffer” was not enough
body: A medical-waste carrier argued that suspension would cause waste buildup and infection risk at client hospitals.
The 1.5-month suspension remained after factors including available alternative operators were considered.
cards.takeaway: Hardship and proof of the statutory conditions are not the same.
cards.pageTurn: Which records help prove the legal test?

sourceTrace.heading: 4. 의료폐기물 업체는 거래처 피해를 주장했지만
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Preserved the argument, reasoning factor and outcome; avoided stating alternative capacity as the sole ground.
sourceTrace.omittedQualification: The Commission considered multiple circumstances not reproduced here.

cards.oneMessage: Evidence must connect the facts to the legal test.
cards.headline: For a waste case, these records shape the analysis
body: Collection cycle and maximum storage period
cards.takeaway: Relevance to the statutory test matters more than document volume.
cards.pageTurn: If conversion is available, is it actually better?

sourceTrace.heading: 4. 의료폐기물 업체는 거래처 피해를 주장했지만
sourceTrace.paragraph: 폐기물처리업에서 이런 주장을 하려면 적어도 다음과 같은 자료
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Grouped the seven source items into four evidence clusters without removing their substance.

cards.oneMessage: Legal availability and economic value require separate analysis.
cards.headline: Even if available, is conversion actually better?
body: Stay suspended — expected operating loss and continuing fixed costs
Check separately — effect on a future repeat-violation analysis
cards.takeaway: After eligibility, compare cost and the effect on the next disposition.
cards.pageTurn: Does conversion erase the violation record?

sourceTrace.heading: 7. 과징금으로 바꾸는 것이 정말 이익일까요?
sourceTrace.paragraph: 최소한 다음 네 가지는 같이 봐야 합니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Reorganized the four factors by choice and long-term effect; preserved each factor.

cards.oneMessage: Changing the disposition does not erase the violation.
cards.headline: Does a surcharge erase the violation record?
body: In the Seoul case, the violation remained; only the form of disposition changed.
The rules for a later repeat violation or another conversion limit must be checked under the applicable Act.
cards.takeaway: Look beyond today's closure to the effect on the next disposition.
cards.pageTurn: What is the full decision order?

sourceTrace.heading: 8. 과징금으로 바뀌면 위반기록도 없어질까요?
sourceTrace.paragraph: 영업정지가 과징금으로 바뀌었다고 해서 위반 자체가 없었던 일이 되는 것은 아닙니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Kept the distinction between the violation and the form of disposition explicit.

cards.oneMessage: Review the whole response sequence before treating a surcharge as an option.
cards.headline: A surcharge is step four—not step one
cards.takeaway: Free review inputs: notice, prior dispositions and financial records. Output: eligibility, calculation route and business impact.

sourceTrace.heading: 12. 사전통지 단계에서 가장 먼저 결정해야 할 것은 ‘과징금 신청’이 아닙니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Preserved the five-step order and recast the approved review inputs and outcomes in natural English.
sourceTrace.omittedQualification: Additional records and procedures may be necessary for an individual case.
